description: ADMIN/TEAM_LEADER 'reopen to IN_PROGRESS' (進行中に戻す) action. Backend: a new reopenSession service (ADMIN all / TEAM_LEADER own-team scoping, COMPLETED→IN_PROGRESS, policy-A preservation of confirmed ConsensusResult and Segment consensusStatus, rejects non-COMPLETED) plus a POST /sessions/{sessionId}/reopen handler that records a SESSION_REOPENED audit log, a new AuditOperationType member, and an api-stack route+Lambda registration. Frontend: a reopenSession service function returning Result<..., AppError>, a ReopenSessionResult type, a Japanese describeReopenError mapper, a flat SessionReopenControls.tsx (Reviewer-hidden, COMPLETED-only) added to the session list via renderSessionActions, and the App.tsx handleReopen wiring. Independent of FEAT-001; runs after it in the shared worktree so overlapping files (session-service.ts, session-api.ts, api-stack.ts, App.tsx, types/session.ts) already carry FEAT-001's edits.
steps: In backend/src/repositories/audit-repository.ts append `| 'SESSION_REOPENED'` to the AuditOperationType union. audit-service.ts re-exports the type, so no change there.

In backend/src/services/session-service.ts add reopenSession(user: AuthUser, sessionId: string): Promise<SessionRecord>: requireRole(user,'TEAM_LEADER'); const session = await getSessionById(sessionId); if (!session) throw notFoundError('指定されたセッションが見つかりません。'); if (!isAdmin(user)) { if (!session.assignedTeamId) throw forbiddenError('このセッションを操作する権限がありません。'); const member = await isTeamMember(user.userId, session.assignedTeamId); if (!member) throw forbiddenError('自チームのセッションのみ操作できます。'); } if (session.status !== 'COMPLETED') throw validationError('完了していないセッションは差し戻しできません。'); return updateSessionStatus(sessionId, 'IN_PROGRESS'); (requireRole, isAdmin, isTeamMember, getSessionById, updateSessionStatus already imported). Do NOT route through changeSessionStatus (VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS.COMPLETED=[]).

Extend backend/src/services/session-service.test.ts for reopenSession: Reviewer→403; TEAM_LEADER own-team COMPLETED→calls updateSessionStatus(id,'IN_PROGRESS'); TEAM_LEADER other-team→403; ADMIN any COMPLETED→IN_PROGRESS; PENDING/IN_PROGRESS→400; not found→404; policy A: only updateSessionStatus is called (no consensus/segment repository writes).

Create backend/src/handlers/post-session-reopen.ts: JSDoc 'POST /sessions/{sessionId}/reopen ...'; export async function handler(event: APIGatewayProxyEventV2WithJWTAuthorizer): Promise<APIGatewayProxyResultV2> that extractUser, validates sessionId (validationError on miss), calls `const updated = await reopenSession(user, sessionId)`, then recordAuditLog({ actorUserId: user.userId, actorRole: user.role, operationType: 'SESSION_REOPENED', resourceId: sessionId, resourceType: 'ReviewSession' }), returns successResponse({ data: { sessionId, status: updated.status } }); outer catch → errorResponse(error). Mirror imports/style of post-session-aggregate.ts. Named export only.

Create backend/src/handlers/post-session-reopen.test.ts: success records SESSION_REOPENED once and returns { data: { sessionId, status:'IN_PROGRESS' } }; missing sessionId → 400; a service AppError (403/404/400) surfaces via errorResponse with the matching statusCode. Mock session-service.js and audit-service.js.

In infra/lib/stacks/api-stack.ts after postSessionAggregateFn add `const postSessionReopenFn = this.createLambda('PostSessionReopen', { entry: handlersDir, description: 'POST /sessions/{sessionId}/reopen - ADMIN/TEAM_LEADER reopen COMPLETED → IN_PROGRESS', environment: commonEnv }); this.grantCommonPermissions(postSessionReopenFn, props);` and after the aggregate addRoute add `this.addRoute('POST', '/sessions/{sessionId}/reopen', postSessionReopenFn, jwtAuthorizer);`.

In infra/test/api-stack.test.ts add a template.hasResourceProperties('AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route', { RouteKey: 'POST /sessions/{sessionId}/reopen' }) assertion mirroring the existing route assertions. If an api-stack snapshot assertion exists and changes, refresh it (npx vitest --run -u).
In frontend/src/types/session.ts add `export interface ReopenSessionResult { sessionId: string; status: ReviewSessionStatus; }`.

In frontend/src/services/session-api.ts add `reopenSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Result<{ data: ReopenSessionResult }, AppError>>` that posts an empty body to `/sessions/${sessionId}/reopen` via this.client.post, mirroring forceAggregateSession; import ReopenSessionResult from '../types/session'.
Extend frontend/src/services/session-api.test.ts: reopenSession calls POST /sessions/{id}/reopen with an empty body; failure returns { ok:false } with the AppError.

Create frontend/src/utils/reopen-error.ts exporting describeReopenError(error: AppError): string with branches 403/'FORBIDDEN'→'このセッションを差し戻す権限がありません。', 404/'NOT_FOUND'→'セッションが見つかりません。', 400/'VALIDATION_ERROR'→'完了していないセッションは差し戻しできません。', else→'差し戻しに失敗しました。時間をおいて再度お試しください。'. Import type { AppError } from '../types/api'.
Create frontend/src/utils/reopen-error.test.ts covering each branch returns the expected Japanese string.

Create frontend/src/components/SessionReopenControls.tsx (flat, mirror of SessionAggregateControls.tsx): props { session: ReviewSession; userRole: UserRole; onReopen: (sessionId: string) => Promise<ReopenSessionResult> }; canManage = userRole==='ADMIN'||userRole==='TEAM_LEADER' else return null; button '進行中に戻す' disabled unless session.status==='COMPLETED' (show supplemental text '完了したセッションのみ差し戻せます。' when not); confirmation step with role="group", aria-controls/aria-expanded wiring, text 'このセッションを進行中に戻します。確定済みの結果は保持されます。実行してよろしいですか。' and 実行する/キャンセル; on success role="status" '進行中に戻しました。'; on failure role="alert" with the thrown Error message.

Create frontend/src/components/SessionReopenControls.test.tsx (vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations()): Reviewer renders nothing; ADMIN/TEAM_LEADER show the button; non-COMPLETED → disabled + supplemental text; confirm→execute calls onReopen(sessionId) and shows success; a rejected onReopen shows a role="alert" error.

In frontend/src/App.tsx SessionListPageWrapper add handleReopen = useCallback(async (sessionId) => { const r = await sessionApi.reopenSession(sessionId); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(describeReopenError(r.error)); await loadSessions(); return r.value.data; }, [sessionApi, loadSessions]); render <SessionReopenControls session={session} userRole={userRole} onReopen={handleReopen} /> inside the existing canManage && (...) block of renderSessionActions (next to SessionAggregateControls); add handleReopen to the renderSessionActions useCallback deps; import SessionReopenControls and describeReopenError.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && npx vitest --run` passes, including the new reopenSession service cases and post-session-reopen handler tests, and asserts a SESSION_REOPENED audit log is recorded exactly once on success.

reopenSession enforces ADMIN-all / TEAM_LEADER-own-team scope, rejects non-COMPLETED with 400, and only calls updateSessionStatus (policy A — confirmed ConsensusResult / Segment consensusStatus untouched).
`cd infra && npx vitest --run && npx cdk synth` passes with the POST /sessions/{sessionId}/reopen route and PostSessionReopen Lambda present (snapshot refreshed if applicable).

SessionReopenControls renders nothing for Reviewer, is COMPLETED-only, confirms before reopening, and reports success/failure accessibly; describeReopenError maps 403/404/400/other to the expected Japanese strings.
`cd frontend && npx vitest --run && npm run build && npm run lint` passes (including vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations on SessionReopenControls).
